post.description:
Registers a new user in the system and provisions their default dashboard.

Args:
    user_in (UserCreate): The payload containing email and password.
    db (AsyncSession): Database session.
    accept_language (str | None): Optional HTTP `Accept-Language` header for localized error messages.

Returns:
    User: The newly created user object.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If email already exists.

OAuth2 compatible token login, issuing an access and refresh token pair.

Args:
    form_data (OAuth2PasswordRequestForm): Login credentials (username=email).
    db (AsyncSession): Database session.
    accept_language (str | None): Optional HTTP `Accept-Language` header for localized error messages.

Returns:
    Token: Access and refresh tokens.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 on invalid credentials or inactive user.

Rotates refresh token and issues a new access and refresh token pair.

Args:
    payload (RefreshTokenRequest): Active refresh token.
    db (AsyncSession): PostgreSQL async database session.

Returns:
    Token: New rotated access and refresh tokens.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

Revokes an active refresh token session.

Args:
    payload (RefreshTokenRequest): Refresh token to revoke.
    db (AsyncSession): PostgreSQL async database session.

Generates a secure password reset token and dispatches reset instructions.

Args:
    payload (ForgotPasswordRequest): Email address of requesting user.
    db (AsyncSession): PostgreSQL async database session.
    email_service (EmailNotificationService): Transactional email service dependency.

Returns:
    PasswordResetResponse: Confirmation message (reset token omitted from response).

Resets user account password and revokes existing sessions.

Args:
    payload (ResetPasswordRequest): Reset token and new password.
    db (AsyncSession): PostgreSQL async database session.

Returns:
    PasswordResetResponse: Success confirmation message.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if reset token is invalid or expired.
    HTTPException: 404 if the user cannot be located.

post.description:
Refreshes data for a SINGLE widget.
Supports `?force_refresh=true` to bypass cache, optional `natural_text` and `processor`
(either as query params or inside `WidgetRefreshRequest`), and optional global filter parameters.

Args:
    dashboard_id (UUID): Target dashboard ID.
    widget_id (UUID): Target widget ID within the dashboard.
    current_user (User): Authenticated user requesting refresh.
    db (AsyncSession): PostgreSQL async database session.
    authorization (str | None): Optional authorization header for forwarding.
    accept_language (str | None): Preferred response language header.
    force_refresh (bool): Whether to bypass query cache.
    natural_text (str | None): Optional user-entered natural text or SQL query.
    processor (str | None): Optional processor override (`'SQL'`, `'ollama:<model>'`, or `'<provider>:<model>'`).
    refresh_request (WidgetRefreshRequest | None): Optional strongly typed widget refresh request body.

Returns:
    dict[UUID, WidgetCachePayload]: Dictionary mapping widget ID to query execution payload.

TemplateInstantiateResponse.title: TemplateInstantiateResponse
TemplateInstantiateResponse.description:
Response payload returned after interpolating a SQL template on the backend.

Attributes:
    template_id (UUID): Identifier of the source template.
    title (str): Default title of the template.
    visualization (str): Recommended visualization type (`metric`, `bar_chart`, `pie`, `table`).
    query (str): Interpolated, SQL-injection-safe DuckDB query string.

TextConfig.description:
Configuration schema for Static Text/Markdown widgets.

TextExecutionPayload.title: TextExecutionPayload
TextExecutionPayload.description:
Strongly typed Pydantic model for a static TEXT/Markdown widget execution payload.

Attributes:
    kind (Literal["text"]): Discriminator tag identifying a static text widget payload.
    status (Literal["success"]): Fixed success status string.
    data (None): Always None for static text widgets.
    error (str | None): Always None for static text widgets.

WidgetRefreshRequest.title: WidgetRefreshRequest
WidgetRefreshRequest.description:
Strongly typed request payload for refreshing a single widget (`POST /dashboards/{id}/widgets/{wid}/refresh`).

Attributes:
    global_params (JsonObject | None): Optional nested global filter parameters dictionary.
    natural_text (str | None): Optional user-entered natural language prompt or raw SQL query.
    processor (str | None): Optional processor override (`'SQL'`, `'ollama:<model>'`, or `'<provider>:<model>'`).
    dept (str | None): Optional clinical department filter shorthand.
    department (str | None): Optional department filter shorthand.
    service (str | None): Optional clinical service filter shorthand.
    start_date (str | None): Optional start date filter shorthand (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
    end_date (str | None): Optional end date filter shorthand (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
    unit (str | None): Optional hospital unit filter shorthand.

WidgetUpdate.title: WidgetUpdate
WidgetUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a widget.
Note: Polymorphism is relaxed on Updates because 'type' is often immutable or missing
in partial PATCH requests. We allow a typed JSON object for config, and individual fields
are validated if matched.

Attributes:
    title (str | None): New title.
    visualization (str | None): New visualization type.
    config (JsonObject | None): Partial configuration updates.
